events.verdict: Jerome (CLE) moves laterally into Tatum (BOS) and initiates illegal body contact.
Jerome (CLE) maintains a forearm against Brown's (BOS) body and does not extend it into him during his shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Tatum (BOS) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and Cleveland is given possession.
Jerome (CLE) briefly places both hands on Brown (BOS) during the pick and the contact is marginal.
Tatum (BOS) grazes Mitchell's (CLE) body during his layup attempt.
Mobley (CLE) jumps alongside of Brown (BOS) during his driving shot attempt and the marginal contact is created by Brown placing his off-arm against him.
Brown (BOS) holds down Mitchell's (CLE) shoulder, affecting his trajectory during the driving shot attempt.
Mitchell (CLE) commits a take foul on Brown (BOS).
Tatum (BOS) contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Mitchell (CLE) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).

Tatum (BOS) initiates illegal body contact to Mitchell (CLE) as he reaches in. Cleveland calls a timeout immediately following the play, but it is changed to an official's timeout due to player injury.
Tatum (BOS) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
